When servers expose an HTTP service (e.g., VShell’s above TCP listener), a common scanner-indexed property is the HTTP response’s body hash. This derived property allows for the easy identification of all indexed servers exposing the same default web page. As an example, the below Snippet 1 computes the HTTP body hashes (SHA256, SHA1, MD5) of the above VShell listener’s decoy “nginx” page. ~$ curl -s http://1
